# Constant `pill_editor::runner::MINIMUM_WINDOW_SIZE`

```rust
pub(in runner) const MINIMUM_WINDOW_SIZE: winit::dpi::LogicalSize<f64> = _;
```

Visibility: `{'restricted': {'parent': 483, 'path': '::runner'}}` · Source: `editor\pill_editor\src\runner\mod.rs:139`

The window's minimum size in logical pixels: the dock's minimum layout
plus room for the menu bar, so a drag of the window's edge cannot leave the
panels unusable.
